posts.text: When I returned from covering Russia’s fullscale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Washington unequivocally and loudly backed Kyiv and condemned Russia. Lawmakers of both parties vowed aid “as long as it takes”. Now, as Russia has found a new way to burn down the country, the U.S. is virtually AWOL. The fundamentals of the war haven’t changed. Only the politics - exacerbated now by the hollowing out of US munitions stockpiles.
